blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Skills provide agents with reusable experience to guide future decisions without modifying the underlying model. However, coding trajectories are often entangled with task- and repository-specific contexts, making it challenging to distill procedural skills that generalize across diverse coding environments. To address this challenge, we present Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE), which progressively distills procedural knowledge from coding trajectories through hierarchical evidence aggregation. HSE first extracts task-level evidence from individual trajectories, then aggregates recurring evidence within the same repository to form repository-specific skill candidates, and finally consolidates consistent patterns across repositories into transferable skills across repositories. The evolution is driven by an external writer-evaluator loop that generates and assesses skills while keeping the underlying coding model frozen. The loop externally updates the writer and evaluator policies to improve subsequent skill generation and assessment. This hierarchy progressively filters task-specific details while preserving procedures that generalize across diverse coding environments. Successful trajectories yield reusable guidance for future tasks, while failed trajectories reveal recurring failure modes that guide avoidance and recovery. We evaluate HSE on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE, using GLM-5.2 across Pi and Claude Code harnesses and GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 with Pi. Across both benchmarks, 10 skills evolved solely from SWE-Gym improve coding performance across all evaluated settings, demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models, and agent harnesses. We further evolve the skill library from target-benchmark trajectories without verifier feedback, relying solely on the learned evaluator for candidate assessment and achieving additional gains through benchmark-tailored skills.
blocks.zh: 技能为代理人提供了可重复使用的经验来指导未来决策,而无需修改基本模式. 然而,编码轨迹往往与任务和寄存器的特定背景相缠绕,因此难以提炼出跨越不同编码环境的通用程序技能. 为了应对这一挑战,我们介绍了分级技能进化(HSE),它通过分级证据汇总逐步从编码轨迹中提炼出程序知识. HSE首先从单个轨迹中取出任务级证据,再将重复出现的证据汇总在同一存储库内,形成存储库特定技能的候选者,并最后将各存储库的一致模式整合为可跨存储库的可转移技能. 演化由外部的写作员-评价员循环所驱动,该循环生成和评估技能,同时使基础编码模型被冻结. 外部循环更新了作者和评价者的政策,以改善随后的技能生成和评估。 这种分级方式逐渐过滤特定任务的细节,同时保留在各种编码环境中通用的程序. 成功的轨迹为未来任务提供了可再用的指导,而失败的轨迹则揭示出反复出现的能指导避免和回收的故障模式. 我们在SWE-bench验证和DeepSWE上评价HSE,使用GLM-5.2跨Pi和Claude Code tapes以及GPT-5.5和用Pi的Opus 4.8。 在整个两个基准中,10个技能完全从SWE-Gym改进了所有评价环境中的编码性能,展示了跨基准、编码模型和代理工具的转移。 我们进一步发展技能库,使其从目标基准轨迹演变而来,没有核查反馈,完全依靠已学习的评审人员进行候选人评估,并通过适合基准的技能取得额外收益。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Skills allow coding agents to reuse experience from previous tasks without modifying the underlying model ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Ouyang et al., 2026b ) .
This is particularly attractive for repository-level coding, where every attempt produces a rich trajectory of searches, code inspection, edits, tests, and recovery actions ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) .
Reusing these trajectories could prevent an agent from repeatedly rediscovering the same repair strategies.
A trajectory, however, is not yet a reusable skill.
It is entangled with a particular issue, repository structure, file paths, and patch, whereas a useful skill should guide future decisions without assuming that these task-specific details transfer.
blocks.zh:
技能允许编码剂在不修改基本模型的情况下重复利用以往任务的经验(Wang等人,2023年;Zhao等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年;Ouyang等人,2026年b).
这对寄存器一级编码特别有吸引力,每次尝试都会产生丰富的搜索、代码检查、编辑、测试和回收行动轨迹(Yang等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年)。
重用这些轨迹可以阻止一种剂反复重新发现同样的修复策略.
然而,轨迹尚不是可重复使用的技能。
它与特定问题、寄存器结构、文件路径和补丁纠缠在一起,而有用的技能应指导未来的决策,而不必假定这些特定任务的细节转移。

blocks.en:
Existing forms of agent experience expose both sides of this problem.
Raw trajectory retrieval preserves concrete evidence but can encourage agents to copy solutions that are specific to a previous task or repository ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
SWESkillsBench provides broadly applicable domain knowledge, but this guidance may not tell an agent how to localize a particular bug, constrain a patch, validate the affected behavior, or recover after an incorrect edit ( Han et al., 2026 ) .
Methods that synthesize or optimize skills from trajectories demonstrate that experience can be converted into reusable instructions ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Ouyang et al., 2026b ; Ni et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) , but a central challenge remains: at what level should evidence be aggregated so that task-specific details are removed without also discarding the procedure that made the experience useful?
blocks.zh:
现有形式的代理经验暴露了这一问题的两面。
原始轨迹检索保留了具体的证据,但可以鼓励代理人复制与以前的任务或存储器具体相关的解决方案(Chen等人,2025年)。
SWES技能 座椅提供广泛适用的域知识,但本指引可能不会告诉代理人如何将特定bug定位,约束补丁,验证受影响的行为,或在编辑错误后恢复(Han等人,2026年).
从轨迹中综合或优化技能的方法表明,经验可以转化为可重复使用的指示(赵等人,2024年;王等人,2024年;欧阳等人,2026年b;倪等人,2026年;杨等人,2026年a;阿格拉瓦尔等人,2026年),但一项中心挑战依然存在:在什么层面上应汇集证据,以便删除具体任务的细节,同时又不放弃使经验有用的程序?

blocks.en:
We address this challenge with Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE) , which uses repository structure as an intermediate level to progressively aggregate task-level evidence into repository-level patterns and cross-repository procedural skills. This hierarchy filters task- and repository-specific details while preserving transferable procedures.
HSE evolves successful evidence into procedural skills and recurring failure signatures into recovery skills for escaping unsuccessful repair directions.
An external writer–evaluator loop jointly evolves the skill library and the policies governing skill generation and assessment ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Ouyang et al., 2026b ; Pryzant et al., 2023 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) , while the coding model remains frozen and receives only the evolved skills.
blocks.zh:
我们通过分级技能进化(HSE)来应对这一挑战。 分级技能进化(HSE)将存储器结构作为中间一级,逐步将任务级证据汇总到存储器一级模式和交叉存储器程序技能中。 这种分级系统在保留可转让程序的同时过滤特定任务和存储库的细节。
HSE将成功的证据发展为程序技能,反复出现的故障签名发展为逃避不成功的修复方向的恢复技能.
外部写作员-评价员循环共同发展技能库和管理技能产生与评估的政策(Shinn等人,2023年;Ouyang等人,2026年b;Pryzant等人,2023年;Agrawal等人,2026年),而编码模式仍然冻结,只获得演化的技能.

blocks.en:
We evaluate HSE with GLM-5.2 under Pi and Claude Code on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE, with additional cross-model evaluation using GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 under Pi.
Ten skills evolved solely on SWE-Gym consistently improve over No Skills and baselines across the target benchmarks and evaluated models, testing whether the learned procedures transfer beyond their source SWE-Gym environment.
We further study target-benchmark adaptation by transferring the learned writer and evaluator policies and updating the skill library from trajectories of the target task set.
This experiment measures whether HSE can continue improving its skill library after exposure to target tasks without access to verifier feedback.

仅仅在SWE-Gym上发展了10种技能,在跨越目标基准和评价模型的 " 无技能和基线 " 上不断提高,检验所学到的程序是否超越了SWE-Gym的环境。

这一实验衡量HSE能否在接触目标任务后继续改进其技能库,而无法获得核查反馈.

blocks.en: • We formulate reusable skill evolution as a hierarchical process, progressing from task-level evidence through repository-conditioned patterns to reusable cross-repository procedures. • We introduce a writer–evaluator framework that evolves successful and failed experience into procedural and recovery skills, while jointly updating the policies that govern subsequent skill construction and assessment. • We evaluate frozen skill transfer, target-benchmark adaptation, component contributions, and cross-harness/model reuse across two coding benchmarks, two agent harnesses, and three underlying models.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
ReAct interleaves reasoning and actions, Reflexion converts feedback into verbal reflection, and Self-Refine iteratively revises outputs using generated feedback ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) .
Voyager stores executable skills, and ExpeL extracts natural-language insights and retrieves past experience without parameter updates ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) .
Agent Workflow Memory induces reusable routines from trajectories ( Wang et al., 2024 ) .
ReasoningBank distills structured reasoning items from both successful and failed experience and retrieves them at test time ( Ouyang et al., 2026b ) .
In coding, SWE-Exp retrieves prior trajectories under explicit leakage controls ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
These approaches motivate experience reuse, but do not perform HSE’s task-to-repository-to-cross-repository aggregation of procedural evidence.

Voyager存储可执行技能,ExpeL摘录自然语言的洞察力,并在没有参数更新的情况下检索过去的经验(Wang等人,2023年;Zhao等人,2024年).

这些方法鼓励经验再利用,但并不执行HSE的任务-存储-存储-存储程序证据的汇总。

blocks.en:
Trace2Skill hierarchically merges trajectory-derived skill patches ( Ni et al., 2026 ) , and SkillOpt aggregates success- and failure-derived edits into bounded skill updates ( Yang et al., 2026a ) .
AutoSkill extracts reusable skills from requirements, SkillOS trains a curator around a frozen executor, and MUSE-Autoskill manages and evaluates evolving skill packages ( Yang et al., 2026b ; Ouyang et al., 2026a ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . SkillRL combines general
and task-specific skills with policy learning ( Xia et al., 2026 ) .
Automatic prompt optimization provides another route to improving external instructions.
ProTeGi edits prompts using textual feedback, whereas GEPA evolves prompts by reflecting on execution traces ( Pryzant et al., 2023 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) .
HSE instead updates the writer and evaluator policies that construct and screen a separately deployable skill library.

4 Hierarchical Skill Evolution
blocks.zh: 4 等级技能演变

blocks.en:
Figure 2 summarizes HSE training as an iterative three-stage process.
First, a frozen coding agent produces execution trajectories and task outcomes.
Second, HSE progressively expands the evidence boundary from tasks (L1), to repositories (L2), and then across repositories (L3).
In parallel, outcome-transition and promotion feedback update the external writer and evaluator rules.
Third, the proposed evolution state is validated and transferred to the next round.

第二,HSE逐渐将证据边界从任务(L1)扩大到寄存器(L2),然后跨越寄存器(L3).
与此同时,成果过渡和促进反馈更新了外部撰写和评价规则。
第三,拟议演化状态得到验证并转入下一轮.

blocks.en: 4.1 L1: Agent Rollouts and Task Evidence
blocks.zh: 4.1 L1: 代理人推出和任务证据

blocks.en:
The frozen coding agent follows a recurring repair cycle with five stages: reproduce the problem, locate the responsible code, edit the implementation, validate the change, and recover when the current direction fails.
Its tool interactions form an execution trajectory. During training, the task-level verifier supplies the observed outcome.
blocks.zh:
冷冻编码剂遵循反复的修复周期,分为五个阶段:复制问题,定位责任代码,编辑执行,验证更改,当当前方向失败时恢复.
它的工具相互作用形成一个执行轨迹. 在培训期间,任务一级核查员提供观察到的结果。

blocks.en:
During training, L1 converts each trajectory into a task-level evidence record containing its five stage annotations and verifier outcome.
The five stage tags—reproduce, locate, edit, validate, and recover—associate files, code locations, patches, and tests with their roles in the issue-solving process.
When a corresponding outcome from the previous evolution round is available, HSE compares it with the current verifier outcome to form an outcome transition label.
This transition determines the strength of the task evidence.
Failed-to-successful and successful-to-failed transitions provide strong positive and strong negative evidence, respectively, whereas successful-to-successful and failed-to-failed transitions provide weak positive and weak negative evidence.
When no paired outcome is available (in the first round), successful and unsuccessful trajectories are conservatively treated as weak evidence.
These labels determine how task evidence participates in subsequent aggregation.
Positive evidence supports candidate skills construction and promotion, negative evidence prevents unsafe promotion, and recurring negative evidence contributes to recovery-skill construction.
blocks.zh:
在训练期间,L1将每个轨迹转换成任务级证据记录,包含其五个阶段说明和核实结果.
五个阶段标记——复制、定位、编辑、验证和回收——相关文件、代码位置、补丁和测试其在解决问题过程中的作用。
当可获得前一轮演化回合的相应结果时,HSE将其与目前的验证结果进行比较,形成结果过渡标签.
这种过渡决定了任务证据的强度.
成功到成功过渡和成功到失败过渡分别提供了有力的正反证据,而成功到成功过渡和失败到失败过渡则提供了薄弱的正反证据.
当没有配对结果(在第一轮)时,成功和不成功的轨迹被保守地视为弱证据.
这些标签决定了任务证据如何参与后续汇总.
正面证据支持候选技能建设和晋升,负面证据防止不安全晋升,反复出现的负面证据有助于恢复技能建设.

blocks.en: 4.2 L2: Repository-Conditioned Candidates
blocks.zh: 4.2 L2: 仓库有条件的候选人

blocks.en:
L2 aggregates labeled task evidence within each repository to identify recurring repository-level regularities.
Candidate support requires repeated positive evidence together with a recurring observable signal, such as a shared code path, edited path, or validation command.
Strong negative evidence acts as a regression constraint and prevents unsafe promotion.
This same-repository boundary preserves useful local structure.
blocks.zh:
L2汇总了每个寄存器内标注的任务证据,以识别经常性寄存器级的规律性.
候选人支持需要重复的正证据以及反复出现的可观测信号,如共享代码路径,编辑路径,或验证命令.
强烈的负面证据是倒退的制约因素,防止不安全的晋升。
这个相同的储量边界保留了有用的局部结构.

blocks.en:
The writer π w \pi_{w} converts supported repository evidence into structured candidates.
Each candidate specifies a trigger, an evidence gate, recommended actions, validation steps, and a stop condition.
The evaluator π e \pi_{e} then assesses the candidate’s empirical support, repetition across tasks, scope, and safety.
It accepts candidates that satisfy the promotion criteria, requests revision when additional specification or evidence is needed, and rejects candidates that are unsupported, unsafe, or overly task-specific.
blocks.zh:
作者 \ w\ pi_{w } 将支持的仓库证据转换为结构化的候选 。
每个候选人指定一个触发器、一个证据门、建议的行动、验证步骤和一个停止条件。
然后评估候选人的经验支持,
它接受符合晋升标准的候选人,在需要额外说明或证据时要求修订,并拒绝不支持、不安全或任务过于具体的候选人。

blocks.en: L2 produces assessed repository-conditioned candidates and retains unresolved failure signatures for separate cross-repository aggregation at L3.
blocks.zh: L2 生成经评估的存储库条件候选人,并保留未解决的故障签名,用于单独的交叉存储库汇总L3.

blocks.en: 4.3 L3: Transferable Skills
blocks.zh: 4.3 L3: 可转让技能

blocks.en:
L3 expands the support boundary from individual repositories to multiple repositories through two complementary aggregation paths.
Procedural skills are evolved from accepted repository-conditioned candidates, while recovery skills are distilled from recurring unresolved failure signatures.
blocks.zh:
L3通过两个互补的聚合路径将支持边界从单个寄存器扩展到多个寄存器.
程序技能是从接受的存储库条件候选人演变而来,而复原技能则从一再发生的未解决故障签名中提炼出来。

blocks.en:
Accepted repository evidence is grouped by recurring procedural features, such as localizing the narrowest supported owner, making a bounded edit, and validating the changed behavior.
When the same procedural pattern is supported by multiple repositories, the writer removes repository-specific identifiers and proposes a transferable procedure.
The evaluator verifies its cross-repository support before promotion.
blocks.zh:
接受寄存器的证据被反复出现的程序特征分组,如将最窄支持的拥有者定位,进行限定的编辑,以及验证改变的行为.
当同一程序模式得到多个寄存器的支持时,编目删除了寄存器特有的识别符,并提出了可转移程序.
评价人员在晋升前核实其交叉存储支持。

blocks.en:
Unresolved failure signatures are aggregated separately across repositories.
Recurring signatures may capture behaviors such as localization drift, a collapsed state distinction, or validation that does not expose the changed behavior.
The writer turns a supported cross-repository failure signature into a trigger and recovery procedure, while the evaluator checks whether the failure condition receives sufficient cross-repository support.
Recovery skills encode triggers and corrective procedures for recognizing and escaping recurring failure modes.
blocks.zh:
未解决的故障签名在储存库中分别汇总。
反复出现的签名可能捕捉到诸如本地化漂移,崩溃的状态区分,或者不会暴露改变的行为的验证等行为.
刻录器将支持的交叉存储器故障签名转换为触发和回收程序,而评价者则检查故障条件是否获得足够的交叉存储器支持.
恢复技能编码触发器和纠正程序,用于识别和逃避反复发生的故障模式。

blocks.en:
The accepted outputs of these two branches form the transferable skill library K t K_{t} .
Cross-repository aggregation filters task- and repository-specific details while retaining procedures supported across diverse coding contexts.
blocks.zh:
这两个分支接受的产出构成可转移技能库K t K_{t}。
跨存储器汇总过滤器具体的任务和存储器细节,同时保留不同编码背景中支持的程序。

blocks.en: 4.4 Writer and Evaluator Rule Updates
blocks.zh: 4.4 作家和评价员规则更新

blocks.en:
During training, HSE periodically updates the external writer and evaluator rules that govern subsequent candidate construction and assessment.
Each update summarizes the task-evidence labels accumulated since the previous update together with the promotion outcomes observed during hierarchical aggregation.
blocks.zh:
在培训期间,高等专业学校定期更新关于随后候选人建设和评估的外部写作和评估规则。
每次更新都总结了自上次更新以来积累的任务证据标签以及分级汇总期间观察到的晋升结果。

blocks.en:
HSE updates the writer rules to determine what evidence and actions may appear in subsequent candidates.
Candidate construction remains grounded in trace-visible evidence and respects the evidence requirements of the corresponding aggregation level.
For example, accumulated unresolved evidence makes subsequent candidate construction more conservative, shifting the writer toward recovery and validation rather than direct editing.
Conversely, successful promotions reinforce evidence patterns that have survived the preceding gates for reuse in subsequent candidates.
These updates shape how the writer constructs future candidates, while candidate promotion remains determined by the evaluator.
blocks.zh:
HSE更新了写作规则,以确定哪些证据和行动可能出现在后来的候选人中.
候选建筑仍以可追踪证据为基础,并尊重相应汇总水平的证据要求。
例如,累积的未解决证据使后来的候选建筑更加保守,使作家转向恢复和验证,而不是直接编辑.
反过来说,成功的晋升强化了证据模式,这些模式在前几次考试中幸存下来,可用于以后的候选人。
这些内容更新了作者对未来候选人的构建方式,而候选人晋升仍由评价人员决定。

Strong-positive and strong-negative evidence induces larger updates than weak evidence, reflecting the greater informativeness of their outcome transitions.

blocks.en: 4.5 Held-Out Validation and Transfer
blocks.zh: 4.5 留存验证和转让

blocks.en:
During training, HSE treats the proposed skills and updated rules as one evolution state.
Before the state is accepted, the current skill library is evaluated on held-out tasks to determine whether performance improves, remains stable, or regresses.
A validated state becomes the new version, and when validation rejects a proposed state, the current accepted version is retained.
blocks.zh:
在训练期间,HSE将提议的技能和更新的规则视为一个演化状态.
在状态被接受之前,对当前技能库进行搁置任务评价,以确定表现是否改善,是否保持稳定,或者是否倒退.
一个被验证的状态成为新的版本,当验证拒绝一个拟议状态时,当前被接受的版本被保留.

blocks.en:
The resulting transfer package contains success skills, recovery skills, and the updated writer/evaluator rules.
The frozen coding agent receives the transferable skills, while the external controller receives the rules required to continue evolution in the next round.
New agent rollouts then provide L1 evidence for the next round, closing the loop in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh:
由此产生的转移包包括成功技能、恢复技能和更新的写作/评价规则。
被冻结的编码代理获得可转移技能,而外部控制器则获得在下一轮继续演化所需的规则.
新的代理推出之后为下一轮提供L1证据,关闭图2中的循环.

blocks.en: 4.6 Training, Static Inference, and Target-Benchmark Adaptation
blocks.zh: 4.6 培训、静态推论和标本马克适应

blocks.en:
During training, HSE uses SWE-Gym trajectories and verifier outcomes to construct the skill library and calibrate the writer and evaluator policies.
At static inference time, the learned state is frozen and only the skill library is provided to the coding agent.
blocks.zh:
在培训期间,厚生科学利用SWE-Gym轨迹和核查结果构建技能库,并校准写作和评估政策。
在静态推论时间,所学状态被冻结,只有技能库提供给编码代理.

blocks.en:
For target-benchmark adaptation, HSE starts from the transferred skill library and fixed writer/evaluator policies, and updates only the skill library using newly collected target-task trajectories.
Candidate updates are assessed by the learned evaluator without access to benchmark verifier outcomes or evaluation-time test results.
blocks.zh:
对于目标基准适应,HSE从转移的技能库和固定的写作员/评价员政策开始,仅使用新收集的目标任务轨迹更新技能库.
候选人更新由学习型评价员评估,但无法获得基准核查结果或评价时间测试结果。

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate HSE on transfer, target-benchmark adaptation, component contributions, and generalization across harnesses and models, with token-cost analysis referred to Appendix A .

blocks.en:
Setup. We evaluate HSE on SWE-bench Verified (500 tasks) and DeepSWE (113 tasks) ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) .
Unless otherwise specified, HSE refers to the frozen skill library evolved on SWE-Gym and transferred to the target benchmark without further adaptation.
We report resolved rate, defined as the percentage of tasks with a successful verifier outcome.
All experiments use GLM-5.2 with Pi and Claude Code (CC) as coding-agent harnesses, except for the cross-model evaluation, which additionally considers GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 with Pi due to the compatibility constraint.

Table 1 compares HSE with No Skills, SWESkillsBench ( Han et al., 2026 ) , GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) , and ReasoningBank ( Ouyang et al., 2026b ) .
HSE achieves the highest mean resolved rate across all four benchmark–harness settings, improving over No Skills by 1.9–4.5 points on SWE-bench Verified and 5.6–7.7 points on DeepSWE.
Notably, these gains are obtained by directly transferring the same skill library evolved on SWE-Gym, without any target-benchmark adaptation.

blocks.en:
HSE also consistently improves over the strongest baseline on each benchmark.
On SWE-bench Verified, it exceeds SWESkillsBench by 0.7–0.9 points, while on DeepSWE it exceeds GEPA by 2.1–3.5 points.
In contrast, SWESkillsBench improves over No Skills on SWE-bench Verified but degrades performance on DeepSWE, suggesting that broadly applicable domain knowledge does not transfer uniformly across coding environments.
HSE’s consistent gains instead support the value of evolving procedural guidance that transfers across repositories and benchmarks.

four settings, indicating more consistent aggregate performance across the
three runs.

blocks.en: 5.2 Target-Benchmark Adaptation
blocks.zh: 5.2 目标基准适应

blocks.en:
Table 2 evaluates target-benchmark adaptation.

Table 3 removes the cross-repository procedural skills or
recovery skills from the deployed HSE pack. Removing either component lowers

across benchmarks.
Procedural removal incurs the larger loss on SWE-bench Verified (1.2 and 3.6 points), while recovery removal incurs the larger loss on DeepSWE (5.3 and 5.6 points).

blocks.en:
Table 4 further isolates the contributions of hierarchical aggregation and controller updates in HSE.
Removing hierarchical aggregation randomly shuffles task trajectories across repositories during skill evolution, disrupting the original hierarchical aggregation while preserving the same trajectories and evidence budget.
This tests whether the hierarchical organization of evidence itself contributes beyond simply exposing the skill evolution process to the same task experience.
This reduces performance by 1.2–2.0 points on SWE-bench Verified and 1.8–3.8 points on DeepSWE.
Removing controller updates instead keeps the hierarchy but freezes the initial writer and evaluator rules throughout skill construction, resulting in losses of 0.6–1.4 and 1.8–2.1 points, respectively.
These results indicate that both the hierarchical organization of evidence during skill evolution and the adaptive policies for constructing and assessing skill candidates contribute to the final transferred skill library.

blocks.en:
The experiments span two benchmarks, two coding-agent harnesses, and three underlying models.
Cross-model evaluation with GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 is conducted only under Pi, and the controller ablation evaluates the writer–evaluator update mechanism as a whole.

blocks.en:
Across SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE, the frozen HSE skill library improves over No Skills under both evaluated harnesses, and the same library remains useful when transferred to GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 under Pi.
Target-benchmark adaptation yields further gains as target-task experience accumulates, while the component and mechanism analyses show contributions from procedural and recovery skills, hierarchical aggregation, and controller updates.

HSE constructs L1 evidence from trace-visible tool interactions.
A deterministic extractor records public execution signals, including touched

together with skill resources actually accessed in the trace, are then
organized by a fixed model prompt into the five repair phases
{ reproduce , locate , edit , validate , recover }.

condition. Invalid model outputs fall back to a deterministic template-based
construction.

blocks.en: D.2 Candidate Representation

blocks.en:
Repository candidates and transferable skills share the representation c = ( trigger , evidence , actions , validation , stop condition ) . c=(\text{trigger},\text{evidence},\text{actions},\text{validation},\text{stop condition}). The trigger identifies when the skill applies, and the evidence gate specifies what must be observed before acting.
Actions define the repair procedure, validation checks the changed behavior, and the stop condition determines when to abandon or re-localize the current direction.
blocks.zh:
仓库候选人和可转让技能共享代表c=(触发,证据,动作,验证,停止条件). c=(\text{trigger},\text{证据},\text{行动},\text{验证},\text{停止条件}). 触发器识别技能何时适用,证据门指定了行动前必须观察的内容.
动作定义修复程序,验证检查改变的行为,停止条件决定何时放弃或重新定位当前方向.

blocks.en:
Repository-conditioned candidates may refer to local APIs, paths, and tests.
L3 distills these candidates into reusable procedural instructions.
Procedural skills aggregate positively supported trajectories, and recovery skills aggregate recurring failure signatures and corrective actions across repositories.
The evaluator accepts, revises, or rejects candidates based on their support, scope, and safety.
blocks.zh:
有条件的入库考生可以参照当地API,路径,考试.
L3将这些候选物蒸馏成可重复使用的程序指令.
程序技能汇总了得到积极支持的轨迹,恢复技能汇总了各存放处反复出现的故障签名和纠正行动。
评价人员根据候选人的支持、范围和安全情况接受、修改或拒绝候选人。

blocks.en: E.1 Training and Validation Split

blocks.en:
From SWE-Gym’s 2,438 tasks across 11 repositories ( Pan et al., 2025 ) , we sample 500 tasks approximately evenly across repositories, using deterministic, evenly spaced sampling within each repository.
The 26 tasks from bokeh/bokeh form the validation set, and the remaining 474 tasks from ten repositories form the training set (approximately 95%/5%).
The two sets share no repositories.

从SWE-Gym的2,438项任务(Pan et al., 2025年)中,
来自bokeh/bokeh的26项任务构成验证组,来自10个仓库的其余474项任务构成培训组(约95%/5%)。
两套设备没有存放处。

blocks.en: E.2 Benchmarks and Evaluation
blocks.zh: E.2 基准和评价

blocks.en:
SWE-bench Verified contains 500 tasks, and DeepSWE contains 113 tasks.
A task is resolved when its patch passes the benchmark verifier.
All resolved rates are computed over the complete benchmark.
blocks.zh:
SWE-bench 验证包含500项任务,DeepSWE包含113项任务.
任务在其补丁通过基准验证器时解决。
所有已解决的费率均按完整的基准计算。

blocks.en: For static HSE evaluation, the transferred skill library is frozen and no target-benchmark trajectories are used for skill construction or updating.
blocks.zh: 对于静态的HSE评价,转移的技能库被冻结,没有目标基准轨迹用于技能构建或更新.

blocks.en:
For target-benchmark adaptation, trajectories from the target benchmark are used to update the skill library, and the resulting library is evaluated on the same complete target task set.
Target-task verifier outcomes are used only to compute the reported resolved rates and are not provided as feedback to the writer or evaluator.
The transferred writer and evaluator policies remain fixed throughout target-benchmark adaptation.
We use a fixed eight-round adaptation horizon for all settings, with no early stopping.
Each round consists of a complete benchmark rollout followed by one writer–evaluator skill update, and we report the resulting library state after every round.
blocks.zh:
对于目标基准调整,使用目标基准的轨迹来更新技能库,由此形成的库则在相同的完整目标任务集上进行评估.
目标任务核查结果仅用于计算报告的解析率,不作为反馈提供给撰写者或评估者。
转让的撰写和评价政策在整个目标基准调整过程中保持不变。
我们对所有环境使用固定的八轮适应视野,没有及早停止。
每轮均包括一个完整的基准推出,然后是一名作家-评价员技能更新,我们每轮报告之后的图书馆状态。

blocks.en:

No Skills uses no additional skill library, and SWESkillsBench supplies the domain-skill baseline.
Static HSE uses ten skills evolved on SWE-Gym, including eight success skills and two recovery skills.
